physicalNotes: Radius 0.38 +/- 0.01 solar radii from Gomez Barrientos et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-6000 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170..148G/abstract): 264,366 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Temperature 3419 +/- 157 K from Gomez Barrientos et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-6000 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170..148G/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
